- SUPER96 FAQ -


Q :

#How To Create An Account?


A :

Click The "REGISTER" Button On The Homepage To Register.


After Successful Registration.. Click The "DEPOST" Button


To Top up And Click The "WITHDRAW" Button To Withdraw Money


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q :

#Can I Register Multiple Accounts ?


A :

Member Cannot Register Multiple Account .Once The Rules Are Violated ,Account 


Will Be Restricted And Members Benefit Will Disqualified.



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q :

#What Are The Deposit And Withdrawal Limit ?


A :

Minimum Deposit AUD10.


Minimum Withdrawal AUD30 ( WITHOUT BONUS) 


*Deposit Of Any Amount " "Requires Rollover x1 " (Total Bet )


*Withdrawals Are 10 Times Daily.



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q :

#Can I Claim Different Bonus At The Same Time ?


A :

Cannot Apply At Same Time For Any Bonus, Promotion ,Rebate ,Commission $Angpao ....ETS.


Although Sometimes You Can On Multiple Different Bonuses, The Will Superimpose The Withdrawal Rules On Different Bonuses. Once The Rules Are Violated Will FORFEIT The Bonus .



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q :

# Why Games Platforms Sometimes Disappear ?


A :

For A Better Game Environment And Effect Sometimes Some Game Platforms Will Be Maintenance. 


During The Maintenance Period, The Game Platform Will Be Temporarily Removed From Website ,Once Done Recovery Website Will Appear Again. 




-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q :

# I Have Met The Rollover Requirement ,Why Can't Withdraw Money ?


A :

Deposit And Applying For Bonus Will Have Rollover Requirements. Once You Complete The Rollover Requirements, Please Exit The Game Complete And Give The system Some Time To Update The Rollover Progress Bar.



Once The Rollover Progress Bar IS Full Withdraw Can Be Made. 



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q :

# Can I Change My Bank Account ?


A :

In Order To Protect Bank Account Of Both Sides, We Are Strict Customer To Change Bank Account , Unless Your Registered Account Is Frozen / Blocked. We Will Verity The Authenticity And Ask For Some Supporting Documents.
